description: The game's real revenue as RevenueCat or Stripe counts it, for a game connected to either in Glitchless Cloud (Settings → Integrations); a game with both gets both unless source picks one. RevenueCat counts production purchases only (never sandbox, TestFlight or licence-tester ones): revenue and transactions by UTC day, MRR, active subscriptions and trials, installs (its new customers: the first time its SDK starts on a device) next to the new players Glitchless saw, active users a day next to Glitchless's players a day, and, where RevenueCat splits them, revenue by the app version purchases were made on, installs, revenue and purchases by country, and revenue by store (App Store, Google Play) next to the sessions Glitchless measured on iOS and Android. Stripe is the game's own account (a web or PC game's unlock, DLC, supporter packs; a test-mode key says so): revenue by UTC day with refunds, disputes, Stripe's fees and net, new paying customers, revenue by product and by country, and revenue by version and platform for the purchases the game tied to a Glitchless session or player (client_reference_id, or glitchless_session / glitchless_player metadata), with how many players paid. Both give revenue per player Glitchless measured, each day next to its sessions and players, each version next to its players, crash-free sessions and frame-time p95, and what the game's own purchase events (track('purchase', { amount, currency })) add up to: the gap is purchases that never reach Glitchless. Use it for money questions, e.g. whether 1.4.2 earns more per player than 1.4.1, or which DLC gets refunded. Use glitchless_events for purchases by item, level or player.

env.description: Only include sessions from this environment, e.g. "prod" (what the game passes to init; builds a developer runs usually send "dev")

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. Ignored with a key for one game.

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 720, 30 days), read as whole UTC days

service.description: Game service name (defaults to the most recently active game)

session_type.description: "user": players only; "tester": people on TestFlight and other test builds only; "synthetic": bots, playtests and store test devices only; "all" or unset: every session. Findings (glitchless_triage, and the overview's) read the production sessions of players unless env or session_type is given

source.description: Only this revenue source (default: every one the game is connected to)

version.description: Only this version: its revenue (where RevenueCat splits revenue by version, or Stripe's purchases joined to that version's sessions) over its players. MRR, subscriptions and trials, and Stripe's refunds and fees, stay the whole game's

title: Revenue
